::: {.callout-note}
## Working research proposition
This page reserves space for evidence about disability-led independent-living and community-living advocacy in British Columbia before Creekview, ECPM, and CSIL. No origins narrative has been written for this bootstrap.
:::

## What this chapter is for

Later work can gather cited accounts of institutional or agency home support, independent-living organising, and any documented experiments that preceded Creekview. Until those sources are catalogued, treat any lineage that starts this chapter as a hypothesis.

## Evidence status

- **Documented facts:** none written as an origins narrative. The earliest inspected public record now catalogued is [Hansard, 24 February 1984](../sources/1984-hansard-mowat-creekview.qmd), which already describes the planned Creekview move.
- **Open questions:** what public primary sources describe independent-living advocacy in British Columbia *before* that sitting, and how (if at all) they connect to Creekview or CSIL.
- **Related wanted sources:** none specifically titled for this chapter in the commissioning issue.
